findings.label: Finding 3 test does not independently exercise _build_mcq inner gate
findings.description: test_build_mcq_inner_similarity_gate_rejects_near_duplicate calls _assemble_quiz rather than _build_mcq directly. The pool-level gate in _build_distractor_pool fires first; if it catches every near-duplicate, the inner gate in _build_mcq is never exercised and could be deleted without this test failing.
findings.fix: Call _build_mcq directly in the test, constructing a distractor pool that already contains a near-duplicate so the pool-level gate has been bypassed. This independently verifies the inner gate.

findings.label: Hard-difficulty test assertions may be vacuously satisfied
findings.description: test_hard_difficulty_produces_valid_questions permits zero questions from the DBMS source. The overlap < 0.05 filter may be strict enough that the 13-sentence DBMS corpus never produces any hard-difficulty MCQs, making the loop body a no-op every run and the hard-overlap path effectively untested.
findings.fix: Run the hard-difficulty assertion against the longer OS source (_LONG_SOURCE) where more sentence pairs are likely to pass the overlap filter, ensuring the structural assertions actually execute.
